mentions.description: An early-stage mini-project attempting to replicate testing of whether AI agents elevate inferred persona, memory, or background context above explicit user requests. The author links to a Bloomberg-reported study on Claude and ChatGPT AI bots offering different shopping prices based on wealth as the study being replicated.
